description: Persistent positive FIT duration 4 months → 5 months
presentation: A 45-year-old man with a history of traveler's diarrhea and a reassuring colonoscopy 1 year ago presents asymptomatic but with a persistent positive FIT now five months after his initial positive result. His initial FIT several months ago was performed to assess prolonged diarrhea after an international trip. During his prior colonoscopy, three polyps were completely removed (pathology: one hyperplastic, two adenomas <1 cm; surveillance recommended in five years). What follow-up evaluation is recommended in light of his prior polyps and ongoing FIT positivity?
